SELECT xm.XM_OID AS id, mo.MO_OID AS rmaNumber,
(SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.status) as status,
xm.RECEIVED_DATE as receivedDate, (SELECT MAX(QA_QC_DATE) from BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_QA xq where xq.XM_OID = xm.XM_OID) as quarantineDate, xm.SCHEDULED_DATE as scheduledDate, part.PART_NUMBER_LONG as partNumber, msn.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber, part.VERSION_NUMBER as versionNumber,
part2.PART_NUMBER_LONG as partNumber2, msn2.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber, part2.VERSION_NUMBER as versionNumber2,
xm.REPAIR_DATE as completedDate, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.CUSTOMER_REPORTED_ISSUE) as customerReportedIssue, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.ESD_KIT) as esdKit, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.PHYSICAL_DAMAGE_PRESENT) as physicalDamagePresent, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.CUSTOMER_ISSUE_REPRODUCED) as customerIssueReproduced, xm.CUSTOMER_REPORTED_ISSUE_EXT as reportedIssueExt, xm.TAMPER_LOG_INTERPRETATION as tamperLog, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.ERROR_MESSAGE) as errorMessage, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.BATTERY_VOLTAGE) as batteryVoltage, xm.REPAIR_DATE as repairDate, (SELECT VALUE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.SUPPORT_ATTRIBUTE_VALUES WHERE SAV_OID = xm.DEPARTMENT) as department, (SELECT TRACKING_NUMBER FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_SHIP xs WHERE xs.BOX_OID = xm.BOX_OID) as trackingNumber, (SELECT CUSTOMER_ORGANIZATION FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_CUSTOMER mc WHERE mc.MC_OID = mo.MC_OID) as customerName,
emp.NAME as assignee, xm.TECH_NOTES as techNotes,
msn.WARRANTY_END_DATE as warrantyEndDate, msn.WARRANTY_VOIDED_DATE as warrantyVoidedDate, (SELECT SHIP_DATE FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_SHIP xs WHERE xs.BOX_OID = xm.BOX_OID) as shipDate, DATE(mo.ORDER_DATE) as orderDate, CASE WHEN msn.WARRANTY_END_DATE IS NULL AND msn.WARRANTY_VOIDED_DATE IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN mo.ORDER_DATE < COALESCE(msn.WARRANTY_VOIDED_DATE, msn.WARRANTY_END_DATE) THEN 'Under Warranty' ELSE 'Out Of Warranty' END AS warrantyStatus FROM MASTER_ORDER mo INNER JOIN XREF_MATERIALS xm ON xm.MO_OID = mo.MO_OID INNER JOIN MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER msn ON msn.MSN_OID = xm.MSN_OID INNER JOIN MASTER_PART part ON part.PART_OID = msn.PART_OID LEFT JOIN XREF_TECHNICIAN xt ON xt.XT_OID = xm.TECHNICIAN LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE_MASTER emp ON emp.EMP_OID = xt.EMP_OID LEFT JOIN MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER msn2 ON msn2.MSN_OID = xm.MSN_OID2 LEFT JOIN MASTER_PART part2 ON part2.PART_OID = msn2.PART_OID
xm.XM_OID = #{id}

SELECT t1.*, CASE WHEN orderType = 3 THEN IF(warrantyStatus = 'Under Warranty', IF(cosmetic = 890, cosmeticPrice, 0), minorPrice + IF(cosmetic = 890, cosmeticPrice, 0)) WHEN orderType = 4 THEN 0 WHEN orderType = 7 THEN diagnosticPrice ELSE 0 END AS unitInvoice FROM (SELECT sn.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber, xma.MSN_OID as msnOID, xma.CUSTOMER_RMA as customerRMA, xma.CUSTOMER_TERMINAL_ID as customerTerminalID, xma.CUSTOMER_REPORTED_ISSUE_EXT as customerReportedIssueExt, xma.XM_OID as pxmOID, xma.COSMETIC as cosmetic, sn.WARRANTY_END_DATE as warrantyExpDate, sn.WARRANTY_VOIDED_DATE as warrantyVoidedDate, xs.SHIP_DATE as shipDate, mp.PART_NUMBER_LONG as model, mp.VERSION_NUMBER as version, COALESCE(rc1.COSMETIC, rc2.COSMETIC) AS cosmeticPrice, COALESCE(rc1.DIAGNOSTIC, rc2.DIAGNOSTIC) AS diagnosticPrice, COALESCE(rc1.MINOR, rc2.MINOR) AS minorPrice, COALESCE(rc1.KEY_INJECTION, rc2.KEY_INJECTION) AS keyInjection, CASE WHEN sn.WARRANTY_END_DATE IS NULL AND sn.WARRANTY_VOIDED_DATE IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN CURRENT_DATE < COALESCE(sn.WARRANTY_VOIDED_DATE, sn.WARRANTY_END_DATE) THEN 'Under Warranty' ELSE 'Out Of Warranty' END AS warrantyStatus,
mo.ORDER_TYPE as orderType
FROM BASIL_SEC_PRD.PREP_XREF_MATERIALS as xma LEFT JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER as sn ON sn.MSN_OID = xma.MSN_OID LEFT JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_PART mp ON sn.PART_OID = mp.PART_OID LEFT JOIN BASIL_SEC_PRD.REPAIR_COST rc1 ON mp.PART_NUMBER_SHORT = rc1.PART_NUMBER_SHORT AND rc1.customer = #{companyId} LEFT JOIN BASIL_SEC_PRD.REPAIR_COST rc2 ON mp.PART_NUMBER_SHORT = rc2.PART_NUMBER_SHORT AND rc2.customer IS NULL AND rc1.RC_OID IS NULL LEFT JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_SHIP xs ON xs.BOX_OID = xma.BOX_OID LEFT JOIN BASIL_SEC_PRD.PREP_MASTER_ORDER mo ON xma.MO_OID = mo.MO_OID WHERE xma.MO_OID = #{id}) t1

SELECT t1.*, CASE WHEN orderType = 3 THEN IF(warrantyStatus = 'Under Warranty', IF(cosmetic = 890, cosmeticPrice, 0), minorPrice + IF(cosmetic = 890, cosmeticPrice, 0)) WHEN orderType = 4 THEN 0 WHEN orderType = 7 THEN diagnosticPrice ELSE 0 END AS unitInvoice FROM (SELECT sn.SERIAL_NUMBER as serialNumber, xm.MSN_OID as msnOID, xm.CUSTOMER_RMA as customerRMA, xm.CUSTOMER_TERMINAL_ID as customerTerminalID, xm.CUSTOMER_REPORTED_ISSUE_EXT as customerReportedIssueExt, xm.XM_OID as xmOID, xm.COSMETIC as cosmetic, sn.WARRANTY_END_DATE as warrantyExpDate, sn.WARRANTY_VOIDED_DATE as warrantyVoidedDate, xs.SHIP_DATE as shipDate, mp.PART_NUMBER_LONG as model, mp.VERSION_NUMBER as version, COALESCE(rc1.COSMETIC, rc2.COSMETIC) AS cosmeticPrice, COALESCE(rc1.DIAGNOSTIC, rc2.DIAGNOSTIC) AS diagnosticPrice, COALESCE(rc1.MINOR, rc2.MINOR) AS minorPrice, COALESCE(rc1.KEY_INJECTION, rc2.KEY_INJECTION) AS keyInjection, CASE WHEN sn.WARRANTY_END_DATE IS NULL AND sn.WARRANTY_VOIDED_DATE IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN CURRENT_DATE < COALESCE(sn.WARRANTY_VOIDED_DATE, sn.WARRANTY_END_DATE) THEN 'Under Warranty' ELSE 'Out Of Warranty' END AS warrantyStatus,
COALESCE(mo1.ORDER_TYPE, mo2.ORDER_TYPE) as orderType
FROM BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_MATERIALS as xm LEFT JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_SERIAL_NUMBER as sn ON sn.MSN_OID = xm.MSN_OID LEFT JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_PART mp ON sn.PART_OID = mp.PART_OID LEFT JOIN BASIL_SEC_PRD.REPAIR_COST rc1 ON mp.PART_NUMBER_SHORT = rc1.PART_NUMBER_SHORT AND rc1.customer = #{companyId} LEFT JOIN BASIL_SEC_PRD.REPAIR_COST rc2 ON mp.PART_NUMBER_SHORT = rc2.PART_NUMBER_SHORT AND rc2.customer IS NULL AND rc1.RC_OID IS NULL LEFT JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.XREF_SHIP xs ON xs.BOX_OID = xm.BOX_OID LEFT JOIN BASIL_ODS_PRD.MASTER_ORDER mo1 ON xm.MO_OID = mo1.MO_OID LEFT JOIN BASIL_SEC_PRD.PREP_MASTER_ORDER mo2 ON xm.MO_OID = mo2.MO_OID WHERE xm.MO_OID = #{id}) t1
